citations.claim: Initial cart position is offset outward 0.436m with outward velocity
Cart close to boundary 2.315m moving outward 1.31 m/s, pole still upright margin 0.72
Violation: cart at 2.4039 outside 2.4 track, pole still balanced theta~0.08

counterfactual.change: Changed initial.x from 0.4367 to 0.0 keeping all else identical; cart stays within track (no violation), showing failure is due to initial offset and lack of position recovery.

explanation: The state-feedback controller prioritizes keeping pole angle small (margin ~0.72 rad at violation) and applies only ~0.8 N despite 65 N limit. With initial x=0.436 and v~0.3 outward, cart drifts monotonically and accumulates velocity ~1.37 m/s, exiting |x|<=2.4 at step 261. The shrunk scenario has no pushes or noise, so failure is purely due to insufficient cart-position regulation / zero steady-state correction, allowing position drift while pole remains balanced.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts steadily to the right toward the track end while the pole stays nearly upright and balanced. At step 261 the cart moves beyond the allowed track boundary, causing the cart_in_track violation.
